Gameplay

Garages

Pick a garage, then drive onto its forecourt.

Nearest first. Tap one to set your route.

Night Shift Taxi

A yellow cab, a busy city, and a sun that won't wait.

Pick up passengers at the green beams and drop them at the orange ones. Quicker trips earn bigger tips.

Driving in VR

Put your headset on, tap Play in VR and you are in the driver's seat. Choose how to steer in Settings, or press X while driving to switch.

Right triggerAccelerate Left triggerBrake, keep holding to reverse Left stickThumbstick steering: push left or right Both gripsWheel steering: grab the wheel and turn your hands. Let go and it straightens XSwitch between thumbstick and wheel steering B (hold)Handbrake AFill up, repair, hide at a garage, confirm YShow or hide the controls card Right stick pressPut the cab back on the road

The screen on the dashboard shows your job, an arrow pointing the way, your speed, takings, fuel and car health. Hold the Meta button to re-centre your view.

Got a VR headset like a Meta Quest? Open this page in the headset's browser to play in VR.

Drive with the arrow buttons at the bottom of the screen. Tap the map or Garages to fix a damaged cab. For full screen, add this page to your home screen.
